explanation: By then Beethoven was almost totally deaf. A singer, the contralto Caroline Unger, turned him to face the hall so he could see people clapping and waving their hats.

claims.text: At the premiere of his Ninth Symphony, Beethoven had to be turned round to see the audience applauding.
Schubert, Weber and Mendelssohn were not turned round to see applause at the premiere of a Ninth Symphony of their own.
Beethoven was almost totally deaf by the time of the Ninth Symphony's premiere.
The contralto Caroline Unger turned Beethoven to face the audience, who were clapping and waving hats.
